description: Read an unexpired converter preview by previewId. No API key. Returns the title, fields, stages, expiresAt, and previewUrl already shown on the public preview page (/tools/p/{previewId}), whether or not that preview was claimed. Unknown or expired ids are not found and include the converter URL. Does not return organization ids or saved form ids.
name: get_preview

expiresAt.description: Unix milliseconds when the preview is deleted.

label.description: Field label shown on the preview.

type.description: Field type, such as short_text or email.

title: Read a form preview
